info.title: Growthlabs API
info.description: This is the API documentation for Growthlabs

post.summary: Login a user and return an access token

404.description: Role not found or validation error

get.description: Returns a list of companies with optional filters. Admin can view all; Organization Managers see companies in their organization via cycle relation.

parameters.name: sector
parameters.description: Filter by sector ID or name

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by company name, sector, city, or team member

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have permission

message.example: You are not authorized to access this resource.

get.description: Returns detailed profile of a specific startup. Access controlled by role: Admin can access all, OrganizationManager startups under their org, Registered only their own.

403.description: Forbidden - user not allowed to access this startup

message.example: You are not authorized to access this resource.

get.description: Returns a list of all countries based on the current app locale (name_en or name_ar).

get.summary: Get list of states for a country
get.description: Returns a list of states for a given country ID based on the current app locale.
Returns a list of all enabled currencies with code, name, symbol, rate, and flag.

get.summary: Retrieve dashboard data for Admin, Organization Manager, Judger, Mentor, or Startup

stepDesc.example: Evaluate startups in the first round.

get.description: Returns a flat list of expertises with localized titles based on the `lang` header.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language preference. Allowed values: en, ar. Defaults to en.

get.summary: Get full profile of a mentor

bio.example: An experienced mentor in business strategy.

get.summary: Get a list of all mentors

bio.example: An experienced mentor in business strategy.

get.summary: Get weekly schedule of a mentor

post.summary: Create new weekly schedule for mentor

get.summary: Get list of all organizations with full details

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter organizations by status (1 = active, 0 = inactive)

403.description: Forbidden - Only admins and org managers can access this endpoint

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the organization to delete

400.description: Organization has dependencies and was soft deleted

message.example: Organization cannot be deleted because it is linked to active cycles or startups.

get.summary: Get current user's permissions grouped by module
get.description: Returns the current authenticated user's roles and permissions grouped by module
Returns the specified user's roles and permissions grouped by module. Admin only.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: User ID to fetch permissions for

get.description: Returns profile data of the authenticated user including mentorship statistics, sessions, and mentor bio if applicable.

entrepreneurialExperience_brief.example: Founded and exited 2 startups in e-commerce

post.description: Update the authenticated user's profile information including contact info, language, timezone, and optionally image.

put.description: Update mentor bio details such as specialization, experience, and mentorship approach.

get.description: Retrieve all programs. Admin sees all, OrganizationManager sees only their organization programs.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status: Upcoming, In Progress, Completed

parameters.name: program_type
parameters.description: Filter by program type (e.g., incubation, acceleration)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search in program title and description

get.summary: Get a specific program by ID
get.description: Returns program details including organization, mentors, steps, and related files.
Returns a list of all roles. Only accessible by Admin users.

post.description: Submit a new mentorship session request with a mentor. Only users with the 'Registered' role can access this endpoint.

duration_minutes.description: Duration of the session in minutes

override_reason.description: Reason for override (required if override_availability is true)

message.example: A session already exists at the selected time.
The selected time does not match the mentor’s availability.

post.description: Submit whether the user attended the session and optionally rate it if attended.

attended.description: Whether the user attended the session

rating.description: Rating given to the mentor (1-5), required if attended is true

message.example: Feedback already submitted for this session.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of past mentorship sessions the startup has attended.
Returns the profile data of the specified user including their role

put.description: Admins can update a user's profile information and role.

403.description: Forbidden - Only admins can update users

get.summary: List users with filters (Admin and OrganizationManager only)
get.description: Returns a paginated list of users, filtered by role or search query. Excludes current authenticated user.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Filter users by role (e.g. Admin, User, Mentor)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by name, email, or phone

post.description: Admins can create a new user with basic profile and role. Sends a welcome email.

403.description: Forbidden - Only admins can create users

patch.description: Deactivates a user account by setting status to 'inactive'. Admins only. Cannot deactivate self or super_admin.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the user to deactivate

message.example: You cannot deactivate your own account.
